figs.name: gas-groups-classification-tree-diagram
figs.alt: gas groups classification tree with Group I mining and Group II IIA IIB IIC gases
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing gas groups: Group I for mining and Group II split into IIA, IIB and IIC by how easily the gas ignites, with example gases.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Gas group classification tree: Group I mining and Group II with IIA, IIB, IIC</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gas Group Classification (ATEX and IECEx)</text>
<rect x="250" y="58" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#b91c1c" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="82.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gas groups</text>
<text x="400.0" y="106.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">by ignition energy</text>
<polyline points="400,118 400,140 200,140 200,160" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="400,140 600,140 600,160" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="162" width="280" height="74" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="193.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Group I</text>
<text x="200.0" y="216.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">mining: methane, coal dust</text>
<rect x="460" y="162" width="280" height="74" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600.0" y="193.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Group II</text>
<text x="600.0" y="216.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">all other industrial areas</text>
<polyline points="600,236 600,256 140,256 140,276" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="400" y1="256" x2="400" y2="276" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="600,256 660,256 660,276" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="20" y="280" width="240" height="150" rx="12" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140" y="314" font-size="26" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIA</text>
<text x="140" y="344" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Least explosive</text>
<text x="140" y="378" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Propane, acetone,</text>
<text x="140" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ammonia</text>
<rect x="280" y="280" width="240" height="150" rx="12" fill="#fdba74" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="314" font-size="26" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIB</text>
<text x="400" y="344" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Moderately explosive</text>
<text x="400" y="378" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Ethylene,</text>
<text x="400" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">coke oven gas</text>
<rect x="540" y="280" width="240" height="150" rx="12" fill="#fca5a5" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="660" y="314" font-size="26" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIC</text>
<text x="660" y="344" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Most easily ignited</text>
<text x="660" y="378" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Hydrogen, acetylene,</text>
<text x="660" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">carbon disulfide</text>
<line x1="60" y1="462" x2="740" y2="462" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="490" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lower ignition energy needed, more dangerous gas</text>
</svg>

figs.name: gas-groups-iia-iib-iic-comparison-infographic
figs.alt: gas group IIA IIB IIC difference in ignition energy, example gases and flame path gap
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing IIA, IIB and IIC gas groups by ignition energy, example gases and flame path gap, which gets narrower as the gas gets more explosive.
figs.after_h2: Difference Between IIA, IIB, IIC Gas Group
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 570" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>IIA IIB IIC comparison of ignition energy, gases and flame path gap</title>
<rect width="800" height="570" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIA vs IIB vs IIC at a Glance</text>
<rect x="190" y="58" width="190" height="46" rx="8" fill="#f59e0b"/>
<text x="285" y="89" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIA</text>
<rect x="390" y="58" width="190" height="46" rx="8" fill="#ea580c"/>
<text x="485" y="89" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIB</text>
<rect x="590" y="58" width="190" height="46" rx="8" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="685" y="89" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIC</text>
<rect x="20" y="114" width="760" height="82" rx="8" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="161" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Ignition energy</text>
<text x="285" y="148" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">High, least</text>
<text x="285" y="174" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sensitive</text>
<text x="485" y="161" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Medium</text>
<text x="685" y="148" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Very low, most</text>
<text x="685" y="174" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sensitive</text>
<rect x="20" y="206" width="760" height="82" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="253" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Example gases</text>
<text x="285" y="240" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Propane, acetone,</text>
<text x="285" y="266" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ammonia</text>
<text x="485" y="240" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Ethylene, coke</text>
<text x="485" y="266" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">oven gas</text>
<text x="685" y="240" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Hydrogen,</text>
<text x="685" y="266" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">acetylene, CS2</text>
<rect x="20" y="302" width="760" height="168" rx="8" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#fecaca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="368" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Flame path</text>
<text x="30" y="392" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">gap</text>
<rect x="225" y="320" width="120" height="38" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="225" y="384" width="120" height="38" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="285" y="454" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wide</text>
<rect x="425" y="320" width="120" height="38" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="425" y="373" width="120" height="38" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="485" y="454" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Medium</text>
<rect x="625" y="320" width="120" height="38" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="625" y="364" width="120" height="38" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685" y="454" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Narrowest</text>
<rect x="20" y="486" width="760" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="522.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">More explosive gas needs a tighter joint to contain an explosion</text>
</svg>

figs.name: gas-groups-equipment-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to select IIA IIB or IIC rated equipment for the gas in the area
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to match equipment to the gas group: IIC equipment fits IIA, IIB and IIC areas, while a IIA area accepts any Group II rating.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to choose equipment gas group rating for a hazardous area</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is the Equipment Rated for This Gas?</text>
<rect x="250" y="56" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Identify the flammable gas</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,135.0 565.0,190 400,245.0 235.0,190" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="185.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gas group of</text>
<text x="400" y="208.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">the area?</text>
<polyline points="235,190 130,190 130,272" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="180" y="178" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIA</text>
<line x1="400" y1="245" x2="400" y2="272" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="412" y="266" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">IIB</text>
<polyline points="565,190 670,190 670,272" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="620" y="178" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIC</text>
<rect x="20" y="276" width="220" height="100" rx="10" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130.0" y="308.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIA area</text>
<text x="130.0" y="332.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">IIA, IIB or IIC</text>
<text x="130.0" y="356.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equipment</text>
<rect x="290" y="276" width="220" height="100" rx="10" fill="#fdba74" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="308.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIB area</text>
<text x="400.0" y="332.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">IIB or IIC</text>
<text x="400.0" y="356.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equipment</text>
<rect x="560" y="276" width="220" height="100" rx="10" fill="#fca5a5" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="308.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIC area</text>
<text x="670.0" y="332.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">IIC equipment</text>
<text x="670.0" y="356.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">only</text>
<line x1="130" y1="376" x2="130" y2="398" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="400" y1="376" x2="400" y2="398" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="670" y1="376" x2="670" y2="398" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="400" width="720" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="429.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Then also match the zone, protection type</text>
<text x="400.0" y="453.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and temperature class</text>
<rect x="40" y="490" width="720" height="70" rx="10" fill="#b91c1c" stroke="#7f1d1d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="519.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IIC rated transmitters fit every Group II area</text>
<text x="400.0" y="543.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and avoid wrong gas group installations</text>
</svg>
